evidence.text: decu (handle: @notdecu) is a content creator who focuses on blockchain and cryptocurrency, with a presence on both Twitter and Twitch at twitch.tv/decu.

identity_candidates.reasoning: Likely the same person. The channel uses the same name, its stream title is about trading Solana memecoins, and it promotes !axiom. The @notdecu account posted that it was banned on Twitch before it could start its 'trading day'. The KOL Explorer profile for the Decu wallet says (per summary) that Decu streams on Twitch. Confidence is not 'high' because no primary cross-link was seen, such as the Twitch About panel linking x.com/notdecu or a tweet linking twitch.tv/decu. The summaries that join the two may be the search model's own inference.
identity_candidates.conflicts_or_doubts: The schedule claims disagree: '12-13 hours a day' (KOL Explorer summary) vs 'Monday through Friday for about 8-9 hours per day' (streamscharts summary). A summary says 'started streaming on Twitch on January 12, 2026', which may be when tracking began rather than when the account started. Twitch follower counts vary (45,709 vs 46.7K). A summary says a tracker shows 'decu wasn't banned', which conflicts with the Feb 2026 ban post (it may have been a temporary suspension).
